source_caption:
Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith (2005)

Revenge of the Sith (2005) follows the final days of the Clone Wars, depicting Anakin Skywalker’s seduction by the dark side to become Darth Vader. Palpatine dismantles the Republic, eradicates the Jedi via Order 66, and forms the Galactic Empire, leaving Obi-Wan and Yoda to fight back while Padmé gives birth to Luke and Leia.

source_details.synopsis: Star Wars: Episode III – Revenge of the Sith is a 2005 American epic space opera film written and directed by George Lucas. The sequel to Attack of the Clones (2002), it is the sixth film in the Star Wars film series, the third installment in the Star Wars prequel trilogy, and the third chronological chapter of the "Skywalker Saga". The film stars Ewan McGregor, Natalie Portman, Hayden Christensen, Ian McDiarmid, Samuel L. Jackson, Christopher Lee, Anthony Daniels, Kenny Baker, and Frank Oz.
